message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic chills and modern scares you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological masterpiece with iconic imagery and an unforgettable score. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | A slow‑burn dread that culminates in a truly shocking finale. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | Sharp social commentary wrapped in a tense thriller. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Suspense built around silence—perfect for a tense Friday night. |
| 5 | **It Follows** (2014) | A fresh take on the “invisible stalker” trope with a haunting soundtrack. |
| 6 | **Midsommar** (2019) | A daylight horror that turns the genre on its head. |
| 7 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | A well‑crafted supernatural tale that keeps you on edge. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological terror that feels personal and deeply unsettling. |
| 9 | **Paranormal Activity** (2007) | Low‑budget found‑footage style that still delivers genuine scares. |
|10 | **The Ring** (2002) | A chilling remake that revitalized the cursed videotape myth. |

Feel free to pick one or two depending on how intense you want your Friday night to be!
